test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

NFTs are

P. digital collectables that exist on

Q. and are better known for recently

R. taking the art world by storm

S. online ledgers known as blockchains
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "**PSQR**." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• **Sentence P** is the first part of the sentence as it begins with the noun 'NFTs' and introduces the topic of the sentence, namely NFTs, which are digital collectibles.
 
• **Sentence S** is the second part of the sentence as it begins with the preposition 'on' and specifies where NFTs exist and how they are created and stored. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence as it ended with 'exist on.'
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is **Option 1**.
 
• **Sentence Q** is the third part of the sentence as it begins with the conjunction 'and' and provides further information about NFTs and why they are significant.
 
• **Sentence R** is the last part of the sentence as it begins with the verb 'taking' and highlights the recent popularity of NFTs in the art world. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
• Therefore, the complete sentence reads:** "NFTs are digital collectables that exist on online ledgers known as blockchains and are better known for recently taking the art world by storm."**

**The correct order is: **__

NFTs are

P. digital collectables that exist on

S. online ledgers known as blockchains

Q. and are better known for recently

R. taking the art world by storm
